column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Life Counseling 2 - Summer Comiket Arc
Anyway, I'd better get going. I'll give you a real good show!
O-Okay! Good luck, Kanako!
Phew...
That... was close.
I-It wasn't just close, I thought I was going to die!
You know, you looked just like Kirino did last year.
Eh?
A year ago when Kirino happened to run into you on the way back, she had the exact same expression as you did just now.
Oh hey, the show's starting.
It's time for Stardust ☆ Witch Meruru!
Aww yeah! KanaKana-chan is here!
The stage is in full swing with both Kanako and her audience singing and dancing together.
Ayase was watching the scene with a serious look on her face.
Okay, seems like we've seen all that we came for.
...Yes.
Tired?
Eh? Not really... No, actually... I'm quite tired.
Thought so. I'm pretty tired, too.
Let's take a short break and then head back.
Yes. It's so hot... My clothes are all sticky with sweat.
I'll have to take a shower when I get home.
...Y-Yeah.
You didn't happen to imagine something lewd, did you?
Just a little.
G-Geez...
B-But uh...
So... How did you like it?
I'm pretty much an otaku by now, so deep down I did have fun today, but...
For someone like Ayase, who doesn't have any interest in these, I imagine being in a hot, smelly and crowded place like this might be quite a bother.
...Honestly, it wasn't very interesting.
Didn't think so.
I really appreciate that you told me straight up. If you'd gone and said you had fun just for my sake, I'd be kind of lost on what to do.
Yes. Still... It's a good thing I came here.
I feel like I can understand a little more about Kirino's hobbies now.
Well, it's not unusual to be reluctant. I was the same last year.
I thought it might be too much at once for Ayase, but it seems like her first visit to 【Summer Comiket】 went just fine.
Besides...
Besides?
...It's nothing.
Okay, I'll make it from here.
Sure, good job today.
Thank you very much for everything, Onii-san.
Sure. See you later.
Yes. Good bye, Onii-san.
Don't worry about it.
I've told you before, I love you the most.
...Is that... really true?
Of course!
Really, really true?
Ayase?
You say that a lot... So I thought you might be joking as always, but...
No way. Have I ever made fun of...
Guess I have.
But don't misunderstand. You're the only person... that I harass like this.
So marry me!
I'm all revved up now. Wait for me, my lovely angel Ayase-tan! I'm coming for you!
Ah, those memories really take me back.
Onii-san, you... big liar.
Sorry.
You're a lewd, lying, stupid, perverted siscon...
She didn't have to go that far.
But yet... you're always so kind.
...Onii-san.
Do you remember... when we first met?
Ah, that time you came over to our place, right?
Back then, she spoke up for me when Kanako was bad-mouthing me.
And...
You were the only one who believed in me.
That made me really happy, you know. I remember thinking that Kirino's really blessed to have such a friend.
Ehehe...
Actually, I thought the same. To have such a kind brother... I was a bit jealous.
Really?
Yes. That's why... when I found out that you were really a pervert, I was shocked and... angry.
Even though it was all a misunderstanding, I couldn't bring myself to forgive you or to make up.
It took me half a year before I could talk to you normally again.
Don't worry about. That was my fault.
Yes. It's very much your fault, Onii-san.
Since you always sexually harass me when we meet... It really made me believe you were a pervert.
And what if you really wanted Kirino... That made me worry a lot.
That's how it was?
Yes.
Good thing that got cleared up.
Yes. Onii-san, you're not a pervert.
You're a super-perverted sexual harasser.
Hey!
But also a very kind person.
So that's how you can deal with it?
Hehe...
Actually... I always end up getting mad at you, don't I?
Do you think... I'm a scary woman?
Well, it does happen that I dream about you and then wake up screaming.
I-Is it that bad?
Yeah. But hey, that's just part of who you are. You're scary, stubborn and when it comes to Kirino, you're kind of disturbing.
Y-You didn't have to go that far.
Still, I know you're not a bad person. It just goes to show how serious you are about things.
And that's why... I love you. Whether you think I'm a masochist or not, but compared to when we first met, I love you even more now.
...Do you like me more than Onee-san?
Eh?
And more than Kuroneko-san?
Do you like me... more than Kirino?
Ayase...
Well, Onii-san?
I don't know. It's kind of difficult to compare.
I see.
Ahaha... That's a load off my mind.
In the end, you're still you, Onii-san.
Well then, thank you for coming with me today.
Sure. See you later.
Yes. Good bye, Onii-san.
I love you the most.
Can I... really believe that?
Yeah.
Are you really sure? I... get jealous easily, you know.
I know. I wouldn't want it any other way.
...I'm so glad.
Onii-san, I... You see...
I don't really know why, but...
Onii-san, I love you.
I love you so very much.
If you're fine with me...
Please let me be your girlfriend, Onii-san!
Yeah, of course.
Well, me too, if you're fine with someone like me...
Ayase, marry me!
I refuse.
But why? You just said you loved me!
That's completely different! I was talking about being lovers; why would you suddenly go and bring marriage into the picture?!
Well, yeah, but in the future...
T-That's still far from now! What I'm asking is just if you will date me! Well?!
I-I'll date you!
Why couldn't you just say that right away?
S-Sorry.
Fine, as long as you understand... Wait, how did it end up like this?!
N-No! My first confession is ruined!
M-My bad.
Scary... My girlfriend is real scary.
...L-Let's start over! I demand that we start over!
O-Okay.
Ahem... I-I'll start then.
Anytime.
Onii-san... I... I love you.
If you're fine with me...
Please let me be your girlfriend, Onii-san.
Yeah. Then I'll be in your care.
Okay, I'm counting on you, Onii-san.
And like that, Ayase and I became a couple.
Wow, I'm actually dating Ayase. Life sure is unpredictable.
Onii-san... Please close your eyes for a moment.
Eh... L-Like this?
Yes. Just stay like that for now.
A-A... Ayase?
Hehe.
Don't tell Kirino, okay?
